product: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global and Polar Grid Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture V006 (SPL3SMP_E)
accessMethod: NASA Harmony server-side bbox + variable subset (HOSS); global daily HDF5 (~650 MB) never downloaded
semantics: Surface (~0-5 cm) volumetric soil moisture (m3/m3; upstream unit string cm**3/cm**3) from the SMAP L-band radiometer, DCA retrieval on the 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 global grid (EPSG:6933). AM = 6:00 descending, PM = 18:00 ascending local solar time passes; cells without a pass that day are NaN (missing, not zero). retrieval_qual_flag bit 0 = recommended quality NOT met (0 = recommended). Soil moisture is not river discharge, groundwater or available water.

processing: Harmony HOSS returned the EASE-2 grid window covering the bbox (cells overlapping the edges are included) with the listed variables; per-day outputs are kept in harmony_subsets/. The combined NetCDF stacks the 7 days on a 'date' dimension, converts fills (-9999 / 65534) to NaN / kept fill, and adds lat/lon of every cell centre computed from EASE-2 x/y (EPSG:6933 -> EPSG:4326). No resampling. Script: scripts/fetch_nasa_s5p_modis_smap.py smap.
